description: Display Git Blame information at the end of code lines with hover details
command.toggle: Git Blame Lite: Toggle Inline Blame
command.showCommitDiff: Git Blame Lite: Show Commit Diff
config.title: Git Blame Lite
config.showStashButton: Show Stash button in source control resource groups
config.rangeBlameThreshold: Files with more lines than this use ranged blame (git blame -L) instead of full-file blame. Set to 0 to always use full-file blame.
config.rangeBlamePadding: Number of lines above and below the cursor to blame in ranged mode. Only effective when a file exceeds rangeBlameThreshold.
